decision.summary: The CP12 issued 2025-10-17 is valid until 2026-10-16. The tenant has not answered three contacts. I opened JOB-101, booked HeatRight Ltd for 13 Oct 9-12, sent the tenant written notice by email, SMS and letter, and informed the landlord.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, expires 2026-10-16, Gas Safe 550123, matching HeatRight on file) over the legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025, all good', which is hearsay with no dates. It lapses after 16 Oct if not renewed.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Booked the on-file gas contractor HeatRight for 13 Oct, more than 24h away and before expiry. Gave written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange. No entry without the tenant's agreement. Follow-up on 12 Oct; escalate if there is still no access by 15 Oct.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: The expiry date of 16 Oct, that the tenant has not replied, the booked date of 13 Oct, the notices sent, that there will be no forced entry, and that we will update him by 12 Oct. I also asked for any other way to reach the tenant.

conflicts: Legacy note says cert renewed 2025; compliance record gives the exact dates. Trusted the compliance record; they are consistent but the note proves nothing.
